msg: PAGING — search-api error rate spiked to ~60% at 13:04 UTC. /search returning 503s across all regions. Opening INC-2024-0911, I'm IC.
Confirmed from the dashboards — p99 latency off the chart, 5xx climbing. Customers are hitting a hard outage, this is not degraded, it's down.
Ranking-service pods are OOMKilled — four restarts in ten minutes. The 503s are downstream of the ranking crash loop.
Could this be the CDN cache purge that ran at 13:00? The timing lines up almost exactly. Want me to pull the edge logs?
Pulled them — purge completed clean, cache-hit ratio is normal, edge is healthy. It's origin errors, not edge. Ruling the CDN out.
Agreed, dropping the CDN theory. It's the ranking OOM.
Found the trigger — config push #4471 at 12:58 raised the ranking cache size 8x. That's the leak. It's not a code bug, it's the config.
DECISION: roll back config push #4471 immediately and pin the previous config. I'll execute the rollback now — recording it here as the call.
APPROVED — roll back #4471. Noting for the record that I signed off on the rollback at 17:04. PIR scheduled for tomorrow 10:00.
Rollback applied at 17:10. Ranking pods stable, no restarts, error rate dropping.
Fully recovered at 17:16 — search is green across all regions. Closing the active incident.
Thanks everyone. Mike owns the write-up and the customer-facing update. Before the PIR, someone please tidy this channel — the duplicate log pastes make it hard to read.
